commands: ( python3 -c 'import flask, importlib.metadata as m; print("flask version:", m.version("Flask"), "file:", flask.__file__)' ) && echo "VERDICT_LINE: PASS pip install Flask from PyPI succeeded and import flask works" || echo "VERDICT_LINE: FAIL import flask failed after pip install Flask"

( cd / && python3 -c 'import flask, importlib.metadata as m; print("version:", m.version("Flask"), "file:", flask.__file__); assert "/tmp/src/src/flask" in flask.__file__, "not the editable checkout"' ) && echo "VERDICT_LINE: PASS pip install -e . from pinned checkout succeeded, editable import resolves to /tmp/src" || echo "VERDICT_LINE: FAIL editable install of pinned checkout did not import from source tree"

( cd / && python3 -c 'import sys, flask, importlib.metadata as m; rp=m.metadata("Flask")["Requires-Python"]; print("python:", sys.version.split()[0], "Requires-Python:", rp); assert sys.version_info[:2]==(3,10); assert rp==">=3.10", rp' ) && echo "VERDICT_LINE: PASS installs and imports on Python 3.10; metadata Requires-Python is >=3.10" || echo "VERDICT_LINE: FAIL install/import on Python 3.10 or Requires-Python metadata mismatch"

setup: mkdir -p /tmp/w && printf '%s\n' '# save this as app.py' 'from flask import Flask' '' 'app = Flask(__name__)' '' '@app.route("/")' 'def hello():' '    return "Hello, World!"' > /tmp/w/app.py
commands: ( cd /tmp/w && python3 -c 'from app import app; r=app.test_client().get("/"); b=r.get_data(as_text=True); print("status:", r.status_code, "body:", repr(b)); assert r.status_code==200; assert b=="Hello, World!"' ) && echo "VERDICT_LINE: PASS README app.py imports and GET / returns 200 'Hello, World!'" || echo "VERDICT_LINE: FAIL README app.py did not import or GET / body was not 'Hello, World!'"

( which flask && flask --help > /tmp/help.txt 2>&1 && head -n 3 /tmp/help.txt && python3 -c 'h=open("/tmp/help.txt").read(); print("has run subcommand:", "run" in h); assert "Usage: flask" in h and "run" in h' ) && echo "VERDICT_LINE: PASS flask entry point exists on PATH and flask --help lists run" || echo "VERDICT_LINE: FAIL flask command missing or flask --help failed"

( python3 -c 'import werkzeug, jinja2, importlib.metadata as m; print("werkzeug:", m.version("werkzeug"), "jinja2:", m.version("jinja2")); reqs=[r.split(">")[0].split("<")[0].split("=")[0].strip().lower() for r in m.requires("Flask")]; print("flask requires:", reqs); assert "werkzeug" in reqs and "jinja2" in reqs' ) && echo "VERDICT_LINE: PASS werkzeug and jinja2 import after Flask install and are declared Flask dependencies" || echo "VERDICT_LINE: FAIL werkzeug/jinja2 not importable or not declared as Flask dependencies"

( cd / && python3 -c 'import importlib.metadata as m; from packaging.requirements import Requirement; from packaging.version import Version; reqs=[Requirement(r) for r in m.requires("Flask") if "extra" not in r]; names={r.name.lower(): r for r in reqs}; print("declared:", sorted(str(r) for r in reqs)); want={"blinker":">=1.9.0","click":">=8.1.3","itsdangerous":">=2.2.0","jinja2":None,"werkzeug":None}; [print(n, "installed:", m.version(n)) for n in want]; assert set(want)<=set(names), set(want)-set(names); [ (lambda n,s: None if s is None else (str(names[n].specifier)==s or (_ for _ in ()).throw(AssertionError((n, str(names[n].specifier), s)))))(n,s) for n,s in want.items()]; [ (Version(m.version(n)) in names[n].specifier) or (_ for _ in ()).throw(AssertionError(n)) for n in want]' ) && echo "VERDICT_LINE: PASS blinker>=1.9.0 click>=8.1.3 itsdangerous>=2.2.0 jinja2 werkzeug declared and all installed satisfying specifiers" || echo "VERDICT_LINE: FAIL declared dependency set or installed versions differ from claim"

setup: cd /tmp/src && pip install --no-cache-dir -q -e . && pip install --no-cache-dir -q pytest asgiref python-dotenv
commands: ( cd /tmp/src && test -f .github/workflows/tests.yaml && echo "workflow present: .github/workflows/tests.yaml" && test -d tests && ls tests | head -n 5 && pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/ 2>&1 | tail -n 5 > /tmp/pt.txt; cat /tmp/pt.txt; python3 -c 'import re; t=open("/tmp/pt.txt").read(); mm=re.search(r"(\d+) passed", t); print("passed:", mm.group(1) if mm else None); assert mm and "failed" not in t and "error" not in t.lower()' ) && echo "VERDICT_LINE: PASS tests.yaml workflow present and pytest suite passes at pinned commit with the pyproject tests group deps" || echo "VERDICT_LINE: FAIL workflow missing or pytest suite did not fully pass"

echo "observed: claim 'one of the most popular Python web application frameworks' has no threshold, metric, or comparison set" && echo "VERDICT_LINE: FAIL unquantified popularity claim is not settleable by execution; escalate to human reviewer"

setup: mkdir -p /tmp/w && printf '%s\n' '# save this as app.py' 'from flask import Flask' '' 'app = Flask(__name__)' '' '@app.route("/")' 'def hello():' '    return "Hello, World!"' > /tmp/w/app.py
commands: ( cd /tmp/w && (flask run > /tmp/w/server.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 5 && cat /tmp/w/server.log && python3 -c 'import urllib.request; b=urllib.request.urlopen("http://127.0.0.1:5000/", timeout=5).read().decode(); print("body:", repr(b)); assert b=="Hello, World!"; log=open("/tmp/w/server.log").read(); assert "Running on http://127.0.0.1:5000" in log, "missing Running on line"' ) && echo "VERDICT_LINE: PASS flask run served Hello, World! and logged Running on http://127.0.0.1:5000" || echo "VERDICT_LINE: FAIL flask run did not start, did not log Running on 127.0.0.1:5000, or did not respond"
